description: Main Flutter application file that initializes the app, defines the root widget, and manages navigation to webview screens displaying local HTML assets. It includes a list of predefined HTML asset files with functions to sanitize user-input paths and handle user interactions.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets up MaterialApp with a theme and home page displaying HTML previews.

classes.name: HtmlListPage
classes.description: Stateful widget that displays a list of HTML files available for preview and provides an input for manual path testing.

methods.name: MyApp.build
methods.description: Builds the root MaterialApp with theme and home page.

methods.name: HtmlListPage.createState
methods.description: Creates the state object for HtmlListPage.

methods.name: _HtmlListPageState.build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including list of HTML assets and debug input.

methods.name: sanitizeAssetPath
methods.description: Sanitizes user input to ensure safe and standardized asset path referencing, enforcing 'assets/<filename>.html' pattern.

methods.name: _openPath
methods.description: Handles user taps or manual input, sanitizes the path, and navigates to WebViewScreen.
